author: NrR1
content: Result: Delivered full AgentRuntime support for Antigravity CLI. crosslink init --runtime antigravity|both now writes .agents/hooks/, .agents/skills/, .agents/mcp/, .agents/hooks.json (merged), mcp_config.json (merged), AGENTS.md (marker-idempotent). Build.rs generates skills_gen.rs. workflow diff shows .agents/ drift. style.rs has agy-hooks/skills path mappings. 13 new passing tests. 4 pre-existing TUI async test failures are unrelated to this change. Kickoff --runtime support deferred to Phase 2 per design doc.
